summary: The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investments purposes) in securities of companies that the Advisor expects to generate a majority of their revenue from technology or enablement through technology. The fund's managers consider technology enabled companies as those whose competitive edge and/or market share are largely based on their technology capabilities. The fund is non-diversified.
